# `Q-2-32` — Triple Star Emphasis Not Allowed

> `***text***` for bold-italic is not supported in Quarto
> markdown; use `*__text__*` (or another nested form) instead.

## What this means

Several markdown dialects accept `***text***` as a shorthand for
emphasis nested inside strong (or vice versa). Quarto markdown
does not. The error fires when an opener of three consecutive
asterisks appears.

## Why this happens

Most often the syntax is carried over from another markdown
dialect (CommonMark, GFM, Pandoc) where it is supported.

## How to fix

Nest the emphases explicitly. Either of these works:

```markdown
*__bold italic__*
**_bold italic_**
```

The two forms produce the same output; the choice is stylistic.
